propositions: an isolated GHA adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery) from Actions API run metadata

a harvest script must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via gh CLI, pass them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (the tracked store, not reports/)
the adapter output must be emitted as snapshots with source label, making them part of the going-forward metrics series independent of GHA log retention window
core metrics modules must not import the GHA adapter to maintain portability and isolation from CI-specific logic
unit tests must validate adapter coverage extraction (fixture log -> 84.2%), red-to-green recovery calculation from paired runs, and correct snapshot persistence to the tracked store path
